phantomstaff.config.title: Phantom Staff Slot
phantomstaff.config.comment.enable_phant: Show and activate the virtual 10th hotbar slot (physics staff).
phantomstaff.config.comment.allow_scroll: Allow the mouse wheel to cycle to the virtual 10th slot.
phantomstaff.config.comment.render_virtu: Render the virtual 10th slot icon on the hotbar.
phantomstaff.config.comment.warn_on_aero: Show a compatibility warning after joining a server that runs Create Aeronautics.
phantomstaff.config.comment.target_line_: Core color of the target line (ARGB).
Core width of the target line.
Maximum tracking distance of the target line in blocks.
Always render the target line through terrain. When off it is hidden by blocks.
phantomstaff.config.comment.open_config_: Hotkey to open the Phantom Staff config menu.
phantomstaff.config.comment.toggle_targe: Hotkey to toggle the physics structure tracking line.
phantomstaff.config.comment.enable_adjus: Clone the physics staff's lock/drag/rotate packets so you can adjust physics structures with hotkeys. Requires holding the physics staff; the server only accepts it while you hold it.
phantomstaff.config.comment.adjust_mode: Hotkey to enter/exit adjustment mode (default B).
phantomstaff.config.comment.adjust_lock: Lock or unlock the aimed physics structure (default L).
phantomstaff.config.comment.adjust_drag: Start or stop dragging the aimed physics structure (default K).
phantomstaff.config.comment.adjust_rotat: Rotate the dragged structure 15 deg around the vertical axis (default TAB).
phantomstaff.msg.aeronautics_warning: [Phantom Staff] Server runs Create Aeronautics (network version %s). The virtual 10th slot only works with old server builds; a newer build may kick you.
